ownerStatement: Approved by repeat98 in chat 14 Oct 2026: release Repitch 0.2.0.
reason: The owner approved this exact native source: 0.1.2 with its runtime package's rate_hook detour replaced by an ev_play_increment subscriber (order 50) using the same RP_SCALE macro; native octabam builds assemble byte-identical. The OT pages and controls are unchanged, so the 0.1.2 captures are retained. Evidence is emulator-only (synthetic register state at the site); current-build hardware, chip worst-case timing and complete memory bounds stay waived for this exact version only, and historical hardware reports stay historical. Native/browser parity, source-only reproduction and repository checks remain required; the release can only publish once a base built with site events ships.
